outcome: fetal acidosis at birth (umbilical cord blood pH < 7.10)
cohort: The study included 24,307 live-born infants with available maternal BMI information, delivered in the Granada north region from 2007-2018, with a specific analysis on 17,167 term live births.
finding: Morbid obesity was identified as an independent risk factor for fetal acidosis at birth, with an adjusted odds ratio of 1.82.
